Final answer (fallback path confirmed after the focused re-attempt): the odds ratio for p53-mediated cell cycle gene regulation (Reactome "p53 pathway mediated DNA damage response") in the Reactome_2022 enrichment of all significant DEGs (p<0.05, |lfc|>0.5, baseMean>10; CBD/cisplatin combination vs DMSO, each n=3) is approximately 0.9 — i.e., OR ≈ 1, no significant enrichment in the combined (up+down) DEG list (Enrichr-style OR = 0.89, overlap 9/1,276, K=87, M=11,000 assumed, hypergeometric p ≈ 0.69). Restricting to up-regulated DEGs alone (exploratory) gives OR ≈ 2.5 (p ≈ 0.049): the p53 program is induced, but most canonical p53 targets (DDB2, PMAIP1, MDM2, XPC, GADD45A) have |log2FC| < 0.5 and are excluded by the specified cutoffs, diluting the combined-list enrichment.

Focused re-attempt outcome (documented in out/final_attempt_log.txt): (1) exhaustive filesystem search found no gseapy, no pydeseq2, no R, no conda, and no *.gmt/Reactome/Enrichr library files anywhere on the runtime — the only Python environments are the minimal system python3.14 and the runner venv (numpy/pandas/scipy/statsmodels/openpyxl only); (2) the sandbox has no network route at all — DNS fails for every host and raw TCP to an external IP on port 443 returns "Network is unreachable", so the live Reactome_2022 library cannot be fetched and gseapy.enrichr cannot be executed here. Per your instruction, the analysis is therefore finalized on the disclosed approximation.

Final deliverable summary:
- DE (executed): self-implemented DESeq2-equivalent NB GLM, Group 9 'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50' (n=3) vs Group 3 'DMSO' (n=3); 15,782 genes tested, 1,361 significant DEGs (268 up / 1,093 down) under literal thresholds; padj(BH)<0.05 robustness gives 1,285; a full 30-sample one-way design with the same contrast gives 1,463 DEGs (96% overlap, same conclusion).
- Enrichment input: 1,276 unique gene symbols (85 ENSGs unmapped; no duplicate symbols among DEGs, dedup removed nothing).
- Target term: "p53 pathway mediated DNA damage response" (closest Reactome_2022 term to "p53-mediated cell cycle gene regulation"); OR ≈ 0.89 (Fisher OR 0.88; OR range 0.81–1.24 for library M = 10k–15k; full-30 design OR = 0.83) — the direction (≈1, not enriched) is robust, the exact value is an approximation because the live Reactome_2022 library was inaccessible.
- Caveat recorded: the Reactome gene set (87 genes) was reconstructed from Reactome knowledge, not the live gseapy/Reactome_2022 library; all artifacts and assumptions are in the outputs listed below.
